title: Prix Courant des Préparations Microscopiques
citation: Joseph Bourgogne, Prix Courant des Préparations Microscopiques (Paris, 1862).
tags: France; slide catalogue; commercial mounter; trade; Bourgogne; slide sizes; pricing
note: A catalogue made specifically for Bourgogne's mounted microscope preparations. Contemporary slides and later analysis show differentiated quality grades and multiple slide formats; this is direct evidence for the French commercial slide trade.

title: Preis-Verzeichniss Mikroskopischer Präparate: Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben
citation: J. D. Möller, Preis-Verzeichniss Mikroskopischer Präparate: Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben (Berlin, 1868), 31 pp.
tags: Germany; slide catalogue; diatoms; mounting materials; trade; Möller; permanent preparations
note: A dedicated price list for microscopic preparations, tools, and materials for making them. The Smithsonian catalogue identifies the 31-page 1868 trade catalogue as microscopic-preparation material rather than a general microscope catalogue.

title: A classified list of first-class microscopic objects, with many unique, rare & interesting specimens
citation: John Thomas Norman, A Classified List of First-Class Microscopic Objects, with Many Unique, Rare & Interesting Specimens (1872).
tags: Britain; slide catalogue; commercial mounter; trade; Norman; mounted objects
note: Norman's only known catalogue listed 2,584 mounted objects for sale. St Andrews uses the surviving slide collection and catalogue together to document his London mounting business and supply relationships.

title: Die Herstellung von Diatomeenpräparaten
citation: Eduard Thum, “Die Herstellung von Diatomeenpräparaten,” Isis 5 (1880): 104.
tags: Germany; diatom slides; mounting technique; Thum; slide making; arranged slides
note: A slide-maker's own published account of producing diatom preparations. Thum ran a professional mounting business and is documented as publishing this slide-making paper in 1880.

title: Ueber das Sammeln und Präpariren der Diatomeen
citation: Eduard Thum, “Ueber das Sammeln und Präpariren der Diatomeen,” Isis 5 (1880): 319–320.
tags: Germany; diatom slides; collecting; preparation; Thum; slide making
note: A second 1880 paper by the professional Leipzig mounter, explicitly connecting collecting diatoms to preparing them as microscope mounts.

title: A Classified List of First-Class Microscopic Objects, with many New, Rare and Interesting Specimens
citation: Edmund Wheeler, A Classified List of First-Class Microscopic Objects, with Many New, Rare and Interesting Specimens, 8th ed. (1880), 32 pp.
tags: Britain; slide catalogue; commercial mounter; trade; Wheeler; prices
note: The Whipple Museum identifies this as a priced 32-page list of microscopic objects manufactured by Edmund Wheeler at 48 Tollington Road, Holloway.

title: A classified list of first-class microscopic objects affording instructive illustrations in anatomy, physiology, botany, entomology, geology & mineralogy
citation: W. Watson & Sons, A Classified List of First-Class Microscopic Objects Affording Instructive Illustrations in Anatomy, Physiology, Botany, Entomology, Geology & Mineralogy (W. Watson & Sons, 1885), 39 pp.
tags: Britain; slide catalogue; commercial preparations; trade; Watson; teaching
note: A stand-alone 39-page catalogue of prepared microscopic objects sold by W. Watson & Sons, useful for reconstructing commercial subject categories and the teaching market for slides.

title: Técnica de las preparaciones microscópicas sistemáticas
citation: Ernesto Caballero Bellido, Técnica de las preparaciones microscópicas sistemáticas (Madrid: Establecimiento Tipográfico de Fortanet, 1897).
tags: Spain; diatom slides; systematic preparations; arranged slides; mounting technique; Caballero Bellido
note: A Spanish publication devoted to Caballero Bellido's technique for systematic microscopic preparations. The IGME library catalogue independently records the 1897 Madrid edition; it directly complements the surviving Caballero diatom-slide collection.

title: Famous mounters - Tempère, father and son
citation: Pierre Girodet, “Famous mounters - Tempère, father and son,” Quekett Journal of Microscopy 38 (1999): 357–363.
tags: France; Tempère; mounters; diatom slides; trade; catalogues; circulation
note: A maker-centred history of Jean and Gaston Tempère grounded in their mounted slides, catalogues, advertisements, and international distribution of diatom preparations.

title: Mounters collectors and sellers of microscopical mounts in France in the 19th and 20th centuries [1] A-L
citation: Pierre Girodet, “Mounters, collectors and sellers of microscopical mounts in France in the 19th and 20th centuries [1] A–L,” Quekett Journal of Microscopy 38 (2000): 573–592.
tags: France; mounters; collectors; sellers; slide trade; provenance; biographical reference
note: A directly slide-centred reference to French mounters, collectors, and sellers, valuable for maker identification, addresses, trade relationships, and provenance research beyond Britain.

title: The 1862 Joseph Bourgogne catalogue of microscopical preparations (English translation with notes)
citation: Pierre Girodet, “The 1862 Joseph Bourgogne Catalogue of Microscopical Preparations (English Translation with Notes),” Quekett Journal of Microscopy 39 (2001): 39–52.
tags: France; Bourgogne; slide catalogue; trade; translation; pricing; slide sizes
note: A translation and annotation of Bourgogne's 1862 slide catalogue. It is a key bridge between surviving French mounts and the commercial language, quality grades, formats, and prices under which they were sold.
